notes.title: Grisaia Chronos Rebellion Release Campaign Present
notes.notes:
To celebrate the release of Grisaia Chronos Rebellion this week, we're giving away 2 sets of 8 acrylic stands of Grisaia characters. Just have a look at our [url=https://twitter.com/FrontwingInt/status/1682616462098464769]Twitter account[/url].

[url=https://twitter.com/FrontwingInt/status/1682616462098464769][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017228/4220fea5db5fb968aea0f8e84882b670003289ca.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Streaming/Let's Play changes for Grisaia Games
notes.notes:
Good news! 

Frontwing has recently changed their stance on Streaming and Let's Play YouTube videos for their Grisaia games. 

You are now allowed to play all the games without restrictions with your subscribers. 

In other news, the Sharin no Kuni Kickstarter has met its initial goal, but Frontwing still need your help hitting the stretch goals! If you haven't had a chance to take a look at the campaign yet, please check it out! 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tokyootakumode/re-sharin-no-kuni-project/
